content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. The Utilization column in the FleetTable detail row now uses the format `0.0%`, so values display as percentages with one decimal place (for example, 0.873 shows as 87.3%).

I only changed the detail cell (`FleetTable_Utilization`); the header and the other columns are untouched. The underlying data is unchanged. The DAX already returns Utilization as a ratio (OperatingHours ÷ ScheduledHours), so no scaling was needed. I didn't run a preview or validation after the edit.
